title: The Alphabet — A Symbol System Acts on a Body
subtitle: Didactic lettering, mechanical type-setting, and animated diagrams pressing upon human faces
theorem: Treat an elementary symbol system (letters, diagrams, and printed instructions) not as neutral pedagogy but as an uncanny pressure acting directly upon a sleepless, dreaming, or cornered body.
boundary_note: Pairs archival typography/diagram clips (`44d4094d`, `df1d9243`, `f9cc73a7`) with expressive human close-ups (`ea5e16f5`, `577428e2`, `ad96ac21`) while keeping each source record distinct.

critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Alternates stark lettering and head diagrams (`44d4094d`, `df1d9243`, `f9cc73a7`) with shadowed faces and sleepers (`ea5e16f5`, `577428e2`, `ad96ac21`).
